===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:inh|enm:hore}}
{{root|en|ine-pro|*keh₂-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|hore}}, from {{inh|en|ang|hōre}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*hōrǭ}}, from {{inh|en|ine-pro|*kéh₂ros|t=loved}}, from {{m|ine-pro|*keh₂-|t=to wish; desire}}. Cognate with {{cog|nl|hoer}}, {{cog|de|Hure}}, {{cog|non|hóra}} as well as {{cog|sa|चारु|tr=cā́ru||dear}}, {{cog|la|cārus||dear, expensive}}, and {{cog|ga|cara||friend}}. 

The unetymological spelling with ''wh-'' superficially denotes a formerly standard pronunciation with an excrescent {{IPAchar|/w/}} (such as in {{m|en|whole}}), but such a form is hardly found in either commentators on Early Modern English pronunciations or records of traditional dialects (which both explicitly mention its rarity or absence), therefore leaving the spelling somewhat inexplicable.<ref name="Dobson">{{R:en:Dobson:1957|II|430|998}}</ref> However, this may be because such an excrescent {{IPAchar|/w/}} was absorbed by a following {{IPAchar|/uː/}} (as in words with etymological {{IPAchar|/w/}} such as {{m|en|whom}}, {{m|en|two}}) after it became established in the spelling but before our earliest orthoepic records.

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}{{tlb|en|now|chiefly|vulgar|and|pejorative}}

# {{senseid|en|prostitute}} {{syn of|en|prostitute}}: a [[person]] ([[especially]] a [[woman]]) who [[offer]]s [[sexual]] [[service]]s for [[payment]].
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Macbeth|1|2|text=The merciless Macdonald – worthy to be a rebel, for that the multiplying villainies of nature do swarm upon him – from the Western Isles of kerns and gallowglasses is supplied, and fortune on his damned quarrel smiling showed like a rebel's '''whore'''.}}
# {{senseid|en|slut}} A person who is sexually [[promiscuous]]; a [[slut]].
#* {{RQ:Burton Melancholy|edition=5th|chapter=Symptomes of Iealousie, Fear, Sorrow, Suspition, Strange Actions, Gestures, Outrages, Locking Up, Oathes, Trials, Lawes, &c.|partition=3|section=3|member=2|subsection=1|page=610|passage=He cals her on a ſudden, all to naught; ſhe is a ſtrumpet, a light huswife, a bitch, an arrant '''whore'''.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2004|author=Dennis Cooper|title=The Sluts|page=250
|passage=So after he fucks the shit out of me, he tells me I'm lying about his '''whore''' not being Brad.}}
# {{senseid|en|unscrupulous person}} A person who is [[unscrupulous]], especially one who compromises their principles for gain.
# A person who will violate behavioral standards to achieve something desired.
# {{senseid|en|term of abuse}} A [[contemptible]] person.
